verdict.rationale: Pika's own docs cover the whole story: a feature that 'scores any clip to picture—music, ambience and foley matched to the action' (pika-docs-4), plus in-platform Text-to-SFX that makes audio for your video (pika-docs-22, pika-docs-62) and music generation (pika-docs-17, pika-docs-61). Missing for 10: any independent or hands-on confirmation of scene-matching quality, and in-depth documentation beyond one-line marketing claims (e.g., how audio is synced or mixed onto the clip).
